description: FREE (key) — Use to qualify, tag or put aside records of a ListPlus list (status, tags, hide). set a status (one of the list's, "" clears it — may start the list's rules, as in the app), add or remove tags, or hide records (restorable; hide: false shows them again) in a list shared with you for editing. Nothing is deleted.

filter.description: Column → value: exact, { "contains": "…" }, { "not": "…" }, { "is_empty": true } or { "condition": "<one of filter_conditions>" }; ar_status by status name

hide.description: true = hide in the list (restorable), false = show again

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)

status.description: A status name of the list (describe_list), or "" to clear

name: mark_records
title: Mark records
